detail.query:
UNLOAD (

SELECT
    nid_poliza,
    nid_endoso,
    vlr_prima,
    fec_expedicion,
    mes_contable,
    cod_sucursal_alfa,
    nom_sucursal_alfa,
    nid_numero_identificacion_tercero,
    nom_tercero,
    periodo
FROM (
    SELECT
        0 AS orden,
        'NID_POLIZA' AS nid_poliza,
        'NID_ENDOSO' AS nid_endoso,
        'VLR_PRIMA' AS vlr_prima,
        'FEC_EXPEDICION' AS fec_expedicion,
        'FEC_PROCESO_POINT' AS mes_contable,
        'COD_SUCURSAL_ALFA' AS cod_sucursal_alfa,
        'NOM_SUCURSAL_ALFA' AS nom_sucursal_alfa,
        'NID_NUMERO_IDENTIFICACION_TERCERO' AS nid_numero_identificacion_tercero,
        'NOM_TERCERO' AS nom_tercero,
        'PERIODO' AS periodo

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        1 AS orden,
        CAST(nid_poliza AS VARCHAR) AS nid_poliza,
        CAST(nid_endoso AS VARCHAR) AS nid_endoso,
        CAST(CAST(SUM(vlr_prima) AS DECIMAL(38,0)) AS VARCHAR) AS vlr_prima,
        date_format(fec_expedicion, '%d/%m/%Y') AS fec_expedicion,
        date_format(fec_proceso_point, '%d/%m/%Y') AS mes_contable,
        CAST(cod_sucursal_alfa AS VARCHAR) AS cod_sucursal_alfa,
        CAST(nom_sucursal_alfa AS VARCHAR) AS nom_sucursal_alfa,
        CAST(nid_nro_identificacion_tercero AS VARCHAR) AS nid_numero_identificacion_tercero,
        CAST(nom_tercero AS VARCHAR) AS nom_tercero,
        CAST(per_proceso_point AS VARCHAR) AS periodo
    FROM "niif-prd-gold-catalog-db"."scd_primas_arl"
    WHERE CAST(per_proceso_point AS VARCHAR) = '$period'
      AND act_reg = 1
    GROUP BY
        nid_poliza,
        nid_endoso,
        fec_expedicion,
        fec_proceso_point,
        cod_sucursal_alfa,
        nom_sucursal_alfa,
                nid_nro_identificacion_tercero,
        nom_tercero,
        per_proceso_point
) q
ORDER BY orden ASC, nid_poliza ASC

)
TO 's3://$assets_bucket/athena/notifications/unload/$execution_id/'
WITH (
    format = 'TEXTFILE',
    field_delimiter = '|',
    compression = 'NONE'
);

total.query:
SELECT
    rst.periodo,
    COUNT(*) AS total_registros,
    CAST(SUM(rst.vlr_prima) AS DECIMAL(38,0)) AS valor_total_primas
FROM (
    SELECT
        CAST(nid_poliza AS VARCHAR) AS nid_poliza,
        CAST(nid_endoso AS VARCHAR) AS nid_endoso,
        SUM(vlr_prima) AS vlr_prima,
        date_format(fec_expedicion, '%d/%m/%Y') AS fec_expedicion,
        date_format(fec_proceso_point, '%d/%m/%Y') AS mes_contable,
        CAST(cod_sucursal_alfa AS VARCHAR) AS cod_sucursal_alfa,
        nom_sucursal_alfa,
        CAST(nid_nro_identificacion_tercero AS VARCHAR) AS nid_numero_identificacion_tercero,
        nom_tercero,
        CAST(per_proceso_point AS VARCHAR) AS periodo
    FROM "niif-prd-gold-catalog-db"."scd_primas_arl"
    WHERE CAST(per_proceso_point AS VARCHAR) = '$period'
      AND act_reg = 1
    GROUP BY
        nid_poliza,
        nid_endoso,
        fec_expedicion,
        fec_proceso_point,
        cod_sucursal_alfa,
        nom_sucursal_alfa,
                nid_nro_identificacion_tercero,
        nom_tercero,
        per_proceso_point
) rst
GROUP BY rst.periodo;
